videos.title: Robots are taking over IFA
videos.description:
All over IFA, there were robots trying to talk, walk, or strut for us. Companies are increasingly bringing humanoid robots to consumer electronics trade shows, pushing them as household helpers and companion bots. But we have yet to see the autonomy and function catch up to the impressive hardware. Right now, it’s still just a runway show.

videos.title: Hands-on with the HoverAir Versa
videos.description:
The Verge’s news editor, Dominic Preston, got hands on with the HoverAir Versa at IFA in Berlin. This model almost slipped by the FCC drone ban in the U.S. by calling itself a camera with attachable wings. Its since been noticed and banned. If you're in the U.S. you can still crowdfund the steadicam, but the likelihood of shipment into the U.S. remains low.
